title: Quake Shareware, a CD-ROM just a little too full
summary: A technical deep-dive by Fabien Sanglard analyzing the Quake shareware CD-ROM packaging and distribution, exploring the technical challenges and innovations of delivering id Software's groundbreaking 3D engine on optical media in 1996.
problem_solved: Documents the technical and logistical challenges of packaging a revolutionary 3D game engine on CD-ROM for shareware distribution in the mid-90s.
why_valuable: Provides rare technical insights into one of gaming's most influential titles and the innovative shareware distribution model that democratized access to cutting-edge 3D graphics.
